verified_clinic_facts: Lead clinician: Dr. Marcus Vance, DC, CCSP (Certified Chiropractic Sports Physician), 12 years clinical experience.
Initial examination duration: 60 minutes comprehensive functional movement & biomechanical evaluation.
Follow-up treatment sessions: 30 minutes 1-on-1 with clinician (never handed off to an assistant).
Average acute injury treatment plan: 4 to 8 sessions over 3 to 6 weeks combined with home active rehab exercises.
source_context.approved_source_material: Standard American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) and ACA Sports Council clinical guidelines on conservative management of lower-extremity overuse injuries.
known_facts: Chiropractors are licensed portal-of-entry healthcare providers in Texas; no general medical referral is legally required for consultation.

Sports chiropractors emphasize joint mechanics and soft tissue mobilization, while physical therapists frequently emphasize motor control re-education and progressive strengthening; collaborative co-management is common.
intentionally_incomplete_facts: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT) is currently under clinical review and is NOT offered at this clinic.
